verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists a BAA/DPA on the Team plan, which supports a HIPAA path for medical records. Enterprise on-prem and air-gapped deployment is aimed at teams that "Require data privacy/operate in highly-regulated environments", so sensitive documents can stay on customer infrastructure. Missing for 10: any documented zero-retention policy for uploaded documents on the hosted API (the docs instead describe file storage and saved checkpoints), any SOC 2 attestation or report, and independent corroboration of the compliance claims.
